## HTML comments

The examples of the [comments module](../../../../docs/specs/dialect/comments.md)
whose behavior `M0` landed: the HTML-comment rule of the inherited grammar. They
are the module's examples in the module's order; the `%%` examples arrive with
`O3`. The expected dumps are the module's expected dumps in the dump grammar of
today, which does not yet print the universal `anchor` and `attributes` fields
that `M7` lands, so every line differs from the module's by exactly
` anchor=null attributes={}` and by nothing else.

An inline HTML comment token is a `Comment` whose literal is the bytes between
`<!--` and `-->`:

```````````````````````````````` example
a <!-- b --> c
.
Document scope=1:1..1:14 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:14 children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 literal="a " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:3..1:12 literal=" b " children=0
    └── Text scope=1:13..1:14 literal=" c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The tokens `<!-->` and `<!--->` are comments with an empty literal:

```````````````````````````````` example
a <!--> b <!---> c
.
Document scope=1:1..1:18 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:18 children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 literal="a " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:3..1:7 literal="" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:8..1:10 literal=" b " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:11..1:16 literal="" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:17..1:18 literal=" c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An HTML block that opens with `<!--` and whose end line holds only whitespace
after the first `-->` is a block `Comment` whose literal is the bytes between
`<!--` and that `-->`, line endings included, and whose scope runs from its
opener line through its closer line:

```````````````````````````````` example
<!-- c -->

<!--
multi
-->
.
Document scope=1:1..5:3 children=2
├── Comment scope=1:1..1:10 literal=" c " children=0
└── Comment scope=3:1..5:3 literal="\nmulti\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Every other HTML block, including one whose end line carries non-whitespace
after `-->`, stays `HTMLBlock` as written:

```````````````````````````````` example
<!-- a --> b
.
Document scope=1:1..1:12 children=1
└── HTMLBlock scope=1:1..1:12 literal="<!-- a --> b\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````
